intro: Our Spice table is where quiet mornings and shared meals find their place — crafted from solid Sheesham wood, it brings warmth and elegance to everyday dining.

features.title: Strength in every setting
features.text: Made from solid Sheesham wood, the frame delivers dependable durability — ready to handle daily meals, quiet moments, and spontaneous guests alike.

features.title: A surface rich with life
features.text: The natural wood grain adds warmth and character, with unique patterns that make each table feel personal and grounded in nature.

features.title: Built to last through seasons
features.text: Termite-resistant and tough at its core, the table is made to stay beautiful over time — requiring only simple care for long-lasting charm.

features.title: Elegance in simplicity
features.text: The minimal design allows the natural materials to shine — clean lines and rich tones create a timeless look that fits in with any décor.

features.title: Sized for meaningful moments
features.text: Perfect for intimate meals and everyday use, the four-seater format offers just the right amount of space to connect, share, and stay close.

name: Spice 4-Seater Solid Wood Square Dining Table
